about: Requests as people write them (Japanese and English) and the skill that owns each (want[0]; others also acceptable). `node lab.mjs skill route --eval` scores the router on them; skill grade's `routed` and skill refine's gate use the result. dev cases may be read while improving triggers.txt and descriptions; held cases must not be (they measure whether a change generalises: never copy their words into a skill). want [] = no skill owns it (the router must name none: a skill that grabs it is loaded for nothing). Add a case when a real request was routed wrong.
